description: This is a test class for the EmploymentStatusAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for API endpoints related to employment status management, including getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete operations.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmploymentStatusAPI endpoints, ensuring proper behavior for CRUD operations and retrieval of employment statuses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, truncates employment status data, and populates fixtures for consistent test data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for retrieving all employment status records.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll test method, reading from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employment status record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getOne test method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employment status via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for create operation.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employment status record.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for update operation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting an employment status record.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for delete operation.
